reviewContext.userProblem: There are two parts. PART A: the working tree holds uncommitted, already-verified work from sessions 708 and 710 that needs a review, real-defect fixes only, and a commit. That work is PDF inline pdf.js canvas rendering, Chilla shortcuts working with a PDF open, Alt/Ctrl+wheel zoom on every preview, and the picker supersession fix. PART B: right-button drag should pan every preview type like dragging a page on a touch screen. The content follows the pointer, and a plain right-click still opens the context menu.
requiredOutcomes: Right-button drag pans Markdown/rendered, source, image (PreviewPane), video (MediaFilePreviewPane) and PDF (PdfFilePreviewPane) previews. scrollLeft/scrollTop move opposite to the pointer delta.
contextmenu is suppressed only when the right gesture moved more than 4px. A plain right-click is not prevented.
Hidden panes do not pan. Left-click, text selection, the existing left-button dragPanEnabled image pan and wheel/keyboard zoom are unchanged.
Vitest covers every preview type, contextmenu in both directions, chord release, and the button-2 to button-1 test edit.
README Keyboard Shortcuts gains one right-drag line.
PART A is reviewed with real-defect fixes only. Existing PDF shortcut, wheel zoom and picker tests still pass.
bun run typecheck, bun run lint:biome, bun run test and test:dom exit 0 with zero failures. The debug tauri build succeeds.
Everything is committed locally after an accepted integration review.
nonGoals: No rewrite, revert or redesign of PART A work.
No platform-specific press-time contextmenu suppression (user QA Options B and C).
No middle-button or touch panning, no inertia, no keymap entry, setting, Tauri command or Rust change.
constraints: Do not modify unrelated files. Do not touch .riela/ or riela-lock.json.
Run Node-based vitest via: mise exec -- env PATH="$(mise where node)/bin:$PATH" bun run test:dom
Do not launch the GUI app in the foreground. PART B GUI checks are delegated to the supervising session (user-accepted gap).

PART A step-8 GUI evidence is tmp/pdf-inline-rendering-20261104-02/pdf-shortcuts-finalize/runtime-observed/RUNTIME-EVIDENCE.md. JPX fixture in GUI, Web Inspector console and video wheel at runtime are user-accepted gaps covered by vitest.
Implementers run no git mutations (no checkout/stash/restore). Commits have no AI attribution, no Co-Authored-By and no emojis.
Workers edit only their writePaths and their own plan progress log. Moving plans to impl-plans/completed/ is handled by the plan-archive node.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: One shared helper, src/features/preview/rightDragPan.ts, exports attachRightDragPan(target, isActive): () => void, RIGHT_DRAG_PAN_THRESHOLD_PX = 4 and RIGHT_DRAG_PANNING_CLASS = "preview--right-drag-panning".
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: This keeps the threshold, the contextmenu rule and the cursor class identical across panes, as previewZoomDirectionFromWheel does for wheel zoom (architecture.md#shared-preview-right-drag-pan).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Do not call preventDefault on pointerdown. Suppress contextmenu only for an active or just-ended pan. The just-ended flag is consumed by contextmenu and cleared on every pointerdown.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A plain right-click keeps the native menu.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: pointermove checks (buttons & 2) first and ends the gesture before scrolling.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A mouse shares one pointer id across buttons. Releasing right while left is held produces a chorded move, not a pointerup.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: isActive is read at event time: props.visible in PreviewPane, isVideo() plus the hidden-ancestor check in the video pane, and !hidden() in the PDF pane.
Implement user QA Option A as written.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The user accepted that macOS WKWebView and WebKitGTK press-time contextmenu may block the pan in the real app. That GUI check is delegated.

intentionalTradeoffs: On macOS WebKit and WebKitGTK, contextmenu fires at press, so right-drag pan may not work in the real app (user-accepted).
The App.css panning class also sets user-select: none, but only while a pan is active.
Per-plan bun run typecheck may fail transiently from a sibling's in-progress wave-2 edits. The serial integration gates are authoritative.
supportedEdgeCases: A move at or below the threshold (4px or less) does not scroll and does not suppress contextmenu.
Chord release (right released while left is held) ends the gesture. Later left-only moves are inert.
pointercancel, lostpointercapture and a different pointerId are handled. A setPointerCapture failure does not break the gesture.
Hidden panes and audio previews do not pan. A gesture that started while visible ends normally.
The detach function removes all listeners and the class.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Native video controls intercepting right-button events at runtime (GUI gap).
Real-app macOS/Linux contextmenu ordering (GUI gap delegated to the supervising session).
EPUB, CSV, raw Markdown editor, HTML iframe preview and diff views.
